# lifesim-rl2t: Content loader accepts content/lots/index.yaml (a lots index with #demonstrates per lot)
task · P2 · auto, lane:sim, no-sandbox

## Description
## Goal
The content loader accepts content/lots/index.yaml (a lots index with a #demonstrates line per lot) and the client can read it.
## Context
The content kind "lot" (content/schema/kinds.json: folder lots, shape thing, schema lot.schema.json) would treat content/lots/index.yaml as a lot file and refuse it. household-lifecycle R2 (accepted, on main) wants content/lots/index.yaml#<id>.demonstrates, one line per shipped lot (today: empty-lot, furnished-flat). Choose a separate kind or an excluded file name (record the choice as a decision with decided_by: session). A new kind is typed once in Sim.Content.Baked/PackBuilder.cs (src/AGENTS.md). Unblocks lifesim-fld.27.3 (lot card line) and the lot part of lifesim-mju. Rules: src/AGENTS.md, design/runbooks/code-structure.md.
## Done when
- content/lots/index.yaml with an entry per shipped lot loads, validates and bakes (just content, just bake).
- A client-readable API (Sim.Composition or ContentPack) returns each lot's demonstrates line; a test covers it.
- A malformed index (unknown lot id, missing demonstrates) fails the content check naming file and id.
- just check green.
## Touches
content/schema/kinds.json, content/schema/lots-index.schema.json (new), content/lots/index.yaml (new), src/Sim.Content, src/Sim.Content.Baked/PackBuilder.cs, src/Sim.Core/Content, PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt, tools/validate_content.py, tests/
## Out of scope
The lot card UI (lifesim-fld.27.3), test households/lots (lifesim-mju).

## Acceptance criteria
content/lots/index.yaml with an entry per shipped lot loads, validates and bakes; just content and just check green; a client-readable API returns each lot's demonstrates line.
